create_masac_algorithm: create a Masac multi-agent SAC algorithm instance with shared critic and delayed Q-value networks
build_continuous_value_module: build a continuous value module for a given agent group using the Masac critic model config
build_discrete_coupled_value_module: build a coupled discrete value module predicting n_agents times n_actions values from global state
build_discrete_decoupled_value_module: build a decoupled discrete value module predicting n_actions values per agent with others actions as input
configure_masac_algorithm: configure a MasacConfig dataclass with target entropy, alpha bounds, and scale mapping for multi-agent SAC
